CreateElasticityAssurance.elasticityAssuranceName: Elasticity assurance name. Rules: supports uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and special characters -_ /.; must start with a Chinese character or letter; length 1-65; can be duplicated. If not named by the customer, it is auto-named as elasticityAssurance-${randomly generated}, following the same naming rules.
CreateElasticityAssurance.spec: Elasticity assurance instance specification, e.g. bcc.g4.c2m8
CreateElasticityAssurance.period: Elasticity assurance purchase duration, supports 1-9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60; unit defaults to month and cannot be changed
CreateElasticityAssurance.autoRenew: Auto-renewal switch, defaults to false; renewal duration is consistent with period
CreateElasticityAssurance.tags: List of tags to be created
